description_en: Invokes this operation to query the configuration information of all image and text watermark templates added in the current service region. The information includes the position, size, and display duration of image watermarks, as well as the parameter settings such as the content, font, color, and position of text watermarks
description_zh: 调用本接口查询当前服务地域下已添加的所有图片水印模板和文字水印模板的配置信息，包括图片水印的位置、大小，展示时间，文字水印的内容、字体、颜色、位置等参数配置信息
name: ListWatermark

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. Default value: app-1000000.

If the multi-application system is enabled, you can specify an application ID to query the image and text watermark templates of a specific application. If you do not specify this parameter, the system returns the image and text watermark templates of all applications by default. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。默认取值：app-1000000。

若已开通多应用体系，传入应用ID，可查询指定应用下的图文水印模板；不传，则默认返回所有应用下的图文水印模板。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time of the watermark template. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 水印模板的创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

FileUrl.description_en:
The URL of the watermark file, which is an OSS URL or a CDN URL.
This parameter is returned only for image watermark templates
FileUrl.description_zh:
水印文件URL（OSS地址或CDN地址）。
仅图片水印模板会返回此参数

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the watermark template is the default image and text watermark template. Valid values:
Default: default image and text watermark template
NotDefault: non-default image and text watermark template
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否是默认图文水印模板：
Default：默认图文水印模板。
NotDefault：非默认图文水印模板

Name.description_en: The name of the watermark template

Type.description_en:
The type of the watermark template. Valid values:
Image: image watermark template
Text: text watermark template
Type.description_zh:
水印模板的类型。
Image：图片水印模板。
Text：文字水印模板

WatermarkConfig.description_en: The configuration information of the image and text watermark in JSON string format, including the display position and effect of the watermark. The configuration parameters for image watermarks and text watermarks are different. For more information about the parameter structure, see [WatermarkConfig](~~98618#section-h01-44s-2lr~~)
WatermarkConfig.description_zh: 图文水印的配置信息（JSON字符串），包括水印显示位置、水印效果等配置。图片水印和文字水印的配置参数不同，参数结构详情，请参见[WatermarkConfig](~~98618#section-h01-44s-2lr~~)
